name: BVG claim options in a plan kept in another currency
workings: Born 1963-03-01; retirement assets 465,000.00 (plan currency; CHF 432,450.00); conversion rate 5.4% at 65, 0.2 points less for each year earlier, more for each later; real interest 0%; Swiss inflation 1%.
The annuity is nominal: in today's francs it changes by 1/1.01 − 1 = -0.009901 a year.
The balance is converted to CHF at 0.93 and the options back: the amounts in the plan's currency are the same as without conversion.
